title: California Government Code section 12950.1 - sexual harassment prevention training
claims: An employer having five or more employees shall provide sexual harassment prevention training.
Supervisory employees must receive at least two hours of classroom or other effective interactive training.
Nonsupervisory employees must receive at least one hour of classroom or other effective interactive training.
Each employer covered by the section shall provide the training to each employee in California once every two years.
New nonsupervisory employees shall be provided training within six months of hire.
New supervisory employees shall be provided training within six months of the assumption of a supervisory position.
